question.prompt: Name a famous astronaut or cosmonaut.
question.criteria: Any real astronaut or cosmonaut who has traveled to space counts, regardless of nationality.

answers.evidence: Neil Armstrong became the first person to walk on the Moon during Apollo 11.
Buzz Aldrin walked on the Moon alongside Neil Armstrong during Apollo 11.
Yuri Gagarin became the first human to travel to space aboard Vostok 1.
Sally Ride became the first American woman to travel to space.
John Glenn became the first American to orbit Earth.
Alan Shepard was the first American in space and later walked on the Moon during Apollo 14.
Valentina Tereshkova became the first woman to travel to space aboard Vostok 6.
Chris Hadfield is a Canadian astronaut whose performance of Space Oddity aboard the International Space Station went viral.
Mae Jemison became the first Black woman to travel to space.
Michael Collins piloted Apollo 11's command module while his crewmates explored the lunar surface.
Jim Lovell commanded Apollo 13 and also flew aboard Apollo 8.
Sunita Williams is an American astronaut who has commanded the International Space Station.
Alexei Leonov performed the first spacewalk during the Voskhod 2 mission.
Peggy Whitson became the first woman to command the International Space Station.
Kalpana Chawla was the first woman born in India to travel to space.
Yang Liwei became the first person sent to space by China's human spaceflight program.
Guion Bluford became the first African American to travel to space.
Helen Sharman became the first British astronaut when she visited the Mir space station.
Rakesh Sharma became the first Indian citizen to travel to space.
Samantha Cristoforetti became the first Italian woman to travel to space.
Eileen Collins became the first woman to pilot and later command a Space Shuttle mission.

question.explanation: Space travelers include lunar explorers, space-station crew members, and pioneers who achieved historic firsts. These are examples, not an exhaustive list.

provenance.brief: Name a famous astronaut or cosmonaut.

Neil Armstrong.reason: Apollo 11 astronaut and the first person to walk on the Moon.

Buzz Aldrin.reason: Apollo 11 astronaut who walked on the Moon with Neil Armstrong.

Yuri Gagarin.reason: The first human in space, aboard Vostok 1 in 1961.

Sally Ride.reason: The first American woman in space, flying aboard Challenger in 1983.

John Glenn.reason: The first American to orbit Earth, aboard Friendship 7 in 1962.

Alan Shepard.reason: The first American in space and commander of the Apollo 14 lunar landing.

Valentina Tereshkova.reason: The first woman in space, aboard Vostok 6 in 1963.

Chris Hadfield.reason: Canadian astronaut and ISS commander whose orbital performance of Space Oddity became widely popular.

Mae Jemison.reason: The first Black woman in space, aboard Endeavour in 1992.

Michael Collins.reason: Apollo 11 command module pilot who orbited the Moon during the lunar landing.

Jim Lovell.reason: Flew on Apollo 8 and commanded Apollo 13, as well as two Gemini missions.

Sunita Williams.reason: American astronaut who has flown to space and commanded the ISS.

Alexei Leonov.reason: Performed the first spacewalk during Voskhod 2 in 1965.

Peggy Whitson.reason: Veteran astronaut who became the first woman to command the ISS.

Kalpana Chawla.reason: The first woman born in India to travel to space, flying aboard Columbia in 1997.

Yang Liwei.reason: China's first astronaut in space, aboard Shenzhou 5 in 2003.

Guion Bluford.reason: The first African American in space, aboard Challenger in 1983.

Helen Sharman.reason: The first British astronaut, visiting Mir in 1991.

Rakesh Sharma.reason: The first Indian citizen in space, flying aboard Soyuz T-11 in 1984.

Samantha Cristoforetti.reason: The first Italian woman in space, launching to the ISS in 2014.

Eileen Collins.reason: The first woman to pilot a Space Shuttle mission and later the first woman to command one.
